proposals.recommendation: split calibration cells from power and misspecification cells
proposals.reason: The frozen grid does not bind procedure and statistic, and nonzero spatial autocorrelation or an unremoved trend is not a type-I null for Moran statistics.

registered_procedures.generative_null: independent identically distributed centered Gaussian values on the registered geometry after applying the frozen missingness mask
registered_procedures.tested_hypothesis: no global spatial autocorrelation under total label exchangeability
registered_procedures.multiplicity_family: one global endpoint per generated map
registered_procedures.comparator: spdep::moran.mc plus exact enumeration when the retained element count permits
registered_procedures.failure_behavior: demote permutation inference if any calibration cell exceeds the frozen null or failed-fit gate

registered_procedures.statistic: elementwise local Moran statistic with the focal centered value fixed
registered_procedures.generative_null: independent identically distributed centered Gaussian values on the registered geometry after applying the frozen missingness mask
registered_procedures.tested_hypothesis: no local association conditional on each focal value
registered_procedures.multiplicity_family: all retained local endpoints within one generated map
registered_procedures.comparator: spdep::localmoran_perm conditional randomization plus exact enumeration on small graphs
registered_procedures.power_or_stress_cells: nonzero spatial autocorrelation or an unremoved trend
registered_procedures.failure_behavior: keep descriptive local statistics but remove stable adjusted-p-value language

registered_procedures.statistic: elementwise local Moran statistic under whole-vector permutation
registered_procedures.generative_null: independent identically distributed centered Gaussian values on the registered geometry after applying the frozen missingness mask
registered_procedures.tested_hypothesis: no local association under total label exchangeability
registered_procedures.multiplicity_family: all retained local endpoints within one generated map
registered_procedures.comparator: independent whole-vector permutation implementation plus exact enumeration on small graphs
registered_procedures.power_or_stress_cells: nonzero spatial autocorrelation or an unremoved trend
registered_procedures.failure_behavior: keep descriptive local statistics but remove stable adjusted-p-value language

excluded_from_c02: ngeo_spin_null remains experimental and requires a separate rotation-invariance design
ngeo_moran_null remains an experimental eigen-sign surrogate and is a negative-control stress test only
review_questions: Approve the separation of calibration from power and misspecification cells?
Approve Holm-adjusted local endpoints as the registered familywise procedure?
Approve excluding spin and eigen-sign surrogates from C02 until separately preregistered?

proposals.recommendation: replace the heterogeneous Cartesian grid with a path-specific benchmark registry
proposals.reason: The meaning of subjects_or_supports and the exact comparator changes by path, so the original 3x3x4 grid does not define 36 comparable workloads.

recommended_path_definitions.workload: sparse change-of-support aggregation with analytic conservation and a registered dense small-case oracle
registered iterative spatial regression solve with fixed tolerance and maximum iterations
checksum-verified blockwise read transform and write of a registered layer matrix
group permutation inference across registered supports and endpoints with one shared schedule

proposals.rejected_interpretation: Do not silently reinterpret subjects_or_supports as a different quantity in each Cartesian cell after observing performance.
review_questions: Approve replacing the 36-cell Cartesian design with path-specific registered cells?
Approve path-specific scale axes and budgets before any new primary benchmark is run?
Approve retaining the seven existing cases only as C08 regression evidence, not VAL-308 primary evidence?

evidence_boundary: This artifact is a reviewable proposal, not an approved amendment, preregistration, calibration result, or release-gate waiver.
